verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way to operate Pipecat itself (deploying agents, managing Cloud resources, running evals) through natural-language commands. The context-hub MCP server is only a local docs, examples and API index for coding agents, and the scaffolded AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files are guidance for external agents. Both are adjacent building blocks or user-side workarounds. The voice bots that Pipecat builds understand natural language, but that is the developer's product, not a way to operate Pipecat.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
